definition: Yummly was an American website and mobile app that provided users recipes via recommendations and a search engine.
details: Yummly used a knowledge graph to offer a semantic web search engine for food, cooking and recipes.
story: Picture an engineer at a cluttered workbench, turning a clever idea over in their hands until it finally clicks. At its heart it is a simple notion, once you strip away the fancy name. A small key that opens a much bigger door. It is one of those ideas that feels obvious only after someone shows it to you. And that idea, made concrete, is Yummly.
